name: address-form
title: Thai address form
description: A Thai address as four codes (province, district, subdistrict, postal code). Type a postal code and the rest fills in; area-first and single-search modes, Thai and English, and a same-as wrapper for a second address. Data comes lazily from the pinned snapshot of the Thai address dataset on data.farzai.com.

const tables: Record<Locale, Record<CopyKey, string>> = { th, en }

export type Translate = (
  key: CopyKey,
  vars?: Record<string, string | number>
) => string

// In English a level label sits mid-sentence ("Select district"), so {k}
// and {f} start lower case there; Thai has no case.
const midSentence = new Set(["k", "f"])

export function createTranslator(locale: Locale): Translate {
  const table = tables[locale]
  const fit = (name: string, v: string) =>
    locale === "en" && midSentence.has(name)
      ? v.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + v.slice(1)
      : v
  return (key, vars) =>
    table[key].replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k: string) =>
      vars && k in vars ? fit(k, String(vars[k])) : m
    )
}

import { createThaiAddress, type ThaiAddress } from "@farzai/thailand-address"

let shared: ThaiAddress | undefined

/**
 * The client every <AddressForm> on a page shares unless one is passed in, so
 * the dataset files are fetched once per page. It reads the snapshot
 * @farzai/thailand-address pins, from data.farzai.com.
 */
export function getThaiAddressClient(): ThaiAddress {
  shared ??= createThaiAddress()
  return shared
}
